verdict.rationale: Llama ships open, downloadable weights (via Hugging Face or Meta's gated request form) that are technically tunable with third-party tooling, and per-family model cards/license docs exist, but there is no first-party hosted fine-tuning API and no explicit self-serve fine-tuning tutorial in the evidence — only download/inference CLI docs. Additionally, llama.com's developer docs are shown to sit behind an SSO wall, undercutting the 'documented self-serve' framing. missing for 10: an official fine-tuning API or step-by-step fine-tuning guide, and open (non-gated) documentation access.
